versions.changelog:
drivethru-production-scheduler 0.4.0 introduces art readiness and improved deadline handling to production batch scheduling.

- Adds prioritization based on art readiness; batches blocked by unfinished decals or unready artwork are deferred until they risk lateness, then are expedited.
- Queue ranking now considers three main factors: manual pins, art readiness (with escalation for urgent jobs), and imminent deadlines (event or ship date).
- Event date logic refined: only events within a set horizon (default 5 days) drive priority; far-off events no longer jump urgent ship dates.
- Queue payload now identifies and reports art blockers and at-risk batches for clearer scheduling decisions.
- Documentation updated to reflect the new art and deadline handling model.
- Removes deprecated skill card documentation (skill-card.md).

drivethru-production-scheduler v0.2.0

- Adds explicit support for run-order scheduling: prioritizes batch ranking (`sequence`) as the main scheduling action, with machine/slot assignment as a refinement where data is solid.
- Manual pins are respected: batches manually reordered by managers keep their place; the system schedules around them.
- Expanded description of the queue ranking rule; now clarifies distinction between automatic and manual priorities.
- Introduces a dedicated run order write-back tool (`production_set_run_order`) and its usage.
- General refocus from automatic slotting to queue management; clarifies scheduling sequence and user roles.
- Removes obsolete skill-card.md documentation.

Initial release of the drivethru-production-scheduler skill.

- Schedules Odoo MRP production batches using live shop-floor ranking rules.
- Reads open batches, ranks by event date, ship date, and readiness, and selects eligible machines for each job.
- Integrates purchase order and vendor tracking data to estimate when jobs can start based on goods arrival.
- Supports quick rescheduling when rush orders arrive by always re-ranking the work queue.
- Communicates with Odoo via the drivethru_mcp MCP server.
- Provides guidance for handling jobs with incomplete receipt, using human feedback to refine scheduling decisions.
